I can’t reliably calculate this many sequential swaps by hand. If you run the assignments in R, this will print the requested line with the final values:

```r
vars <- c("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h",
          "i", "j", "k", "l", "m", "n", "o", "p", "TMP")
cat("ANSWER: ",
    paste(sprintf("%s ?= %s", vars,
                  vapply(vars, \(x) as.character(get(x)), "")),
          collapse = "; "),
    ";\n", sep = "")
```
